description:
Create a mileage expense in FreeAgent. Provide either origin + destination (requires ORS_API_KEY or GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY for distance lookup) or manualMiles for the journey distance. Set roundTrip=true to double the distance.

The claim value is calculated by FreeAgent from the mileage rate configured on the account (this is what HMRC reporting in FreeAgent uses). ratePence / cumulativeMilesYTD only produce an advisory estimate in the response for cross-checking — they do not change what is filed.

cumulativeMilesYTD.description: Cumulative business miles already claimed this tax year. Used for HMRC threshold logic (high rate → low rate at threshold). Only relevant when ratePence is not set.

description.description: Journey description (e.g. 'Office to client site, quarterly review')

destination.description: Destination address. Requires distance API key. Omit if providing manualMiles.

engineSize.description: Engine size band as FreeAgent labels it (e.g. 'Up to 1400cc', '1401-2000cc', 'Over 2000cc', 'All'). The valid bands vary by date and engine type.

engineType.description: Fuel or power type. Needed with engineSize to reclaim the VAT on the fuel element of the claim — without them FreeAgent has nothing to calculate it from.

haveVatReceipt.description: Whether a VAT receipt for the fuel was kept — required to reclaim the VAT

manualMiles.description: Journey distance in miles (use instead of origin/destination)

origin.description: Origin address. Requires distance API key. Omit if providing manualMiles.

project.description: FreeAgent project URL to tag the journey against

ratePence.description: Pence per mile (e.g. 45) used only for the advisory estimate in the response. FreeAgent applies the mileage rate configured on the account when filing the claim.

rebillFactor.description: Markup percentage or fixed price — required for markup/price

rebillType.description: How to rebill this to the client — 'cost' bills it on at cost, 'markup' adds a percentage, 'price' charges a fixed price. Requires project. Without it the expense is attributed to the project but never queued to bill on.

roundTrip.description: Double the distance for a return journey

vehicleType.description: Vehicle used for the journey (required by FreeAgent's mileage category)

name: freeagent_create_mileage_expense
